// paths: required trio — relative values resolve against this file's directory
// models: lanes: normal analysis, optional cheap fast model, opt-in external lane, embeddings
// ollama_task_models: per-task model lists — first entry is the default, rest are UI alternatives
// limits: request_timeout_seconds covers full analysis; enrichment_* bound the optional fast pass
// scanning: what the filesystem walk picks up and skips
// exclude_extensions: removes entries from the extensions allowlist — here .markdown is ignored
// server + logging: loopback-only HTTP; log_file tees stderr to a file, log_level 'debug' adds request/job lines
// validate: exempt paths skip frontmatter/index requirements in `KBM-flow validate`
// report: read-only fleet report — registry/policy resolve relative to this file; remote_enabled false = local checks only
